name: sameem-hub-production
description: Sameem Hub — Netlify monorepo. Next.js landing + dashboard at /dashboard + Express/Prisma sync API at /api.
//deps: serverless-http must live at the ROOT, not in backend/. esbuild resolves imports relative to the importing file, and netlify/functions/api.ts sits at the repo root — so it can only see root node_modules.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.netlify:build: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix backend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build
